page.layout: One page of running text in one column; no margin notes. Running head at top centre above the text. Below the text: a closing line "FINIS." in spaced capitals, centred.

main_text.p: X. De vtilitate vero epistolarũ qd multa nũc me scribere necesse est: ad te praesertim, q nõ legisti modo Ciceronis epistolas diligeter; verum etiã in succu atq; sanguine conuertere eafdẽ didicisti: ad parentes, praeceptores, mecoenates, amicos scribis creberrimè?

XI. Si verum est, vt est, quod ad Curionẽ Cicero scribit, inuentas propterea epistolas esse, vt iis certiores amicos reddamus, si quid eos scire, aut nostra, aut ipsorum interest: si nihil fere in rebus reperitur humanis, quod epistolis non committatur: si nihil dulcius & suauius, quàm cum eo, qui etiam longè à nobis abest, quasi praesente posse colloqui nostraq; confilia communicare: si nemo in orationibus conscribendis felix esse poterit, nisi in contexendis epistolis diu ante multumq; exercitatus fuerit: quis est, qui non quàm longè lateq; earundem sefe proferat cum vtilitas, tum oblectatio intelligit?
XII. Habes meam de epistolis sententiam breuiter indicatã: quae vti spero, tibi quoq; probabitur.
XIII. Sin verò aliud forte vifum tibi fuerit, amici tamen fungi me voluisse officio statues, eoq; nomine, quae sunt allata, grata habebis.
XIIII. Quicquid autem & in hoc genere studij, & aliis instituerris: id Deus Opt. Max. vt fortunet, ex animo precor.

page.notes: Several words show the long s as a plain s and some words are run together in the scan (e.g. "scribere", "praesertim") — transcribed as printed where readable. The "FINIS." line is a closing word and is therefore a paragraph. Some ligatures and characters near the binding are faint; words marked [?] were not fully certain: none were individually flagged in this pass, but the text near "succu atq;" and "sanguine" and the Latin of section XIII are the least certain readings and should be checked against the scan.
